image.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / editorial illustration.
Asset type: a striking premium Persian article cover, landscape 16:9, about participatory contracts for independent IT and AI companies.
Core message: partnership under oppressive bureaucratic rigidity, with a small but real glimmer of hope created through a legally valid joint contract. Show these FOUR ideas immediately and clearly: collaboration, law, an IRON HEEL, and a narrow hopeful way forward.
Scene: dramatic surreal architectural miniature with photorealistic materials. In the upper-left and middle background, an enormous dark cast-iron formal shoe with an unmistakable heavy block heel, rivets, worn iron and weight dominates the scene. It bears down on a crushing pile of administrative folders, tangled red tape and rigid stone barriers, casting a large shadow across a small technology business landscape. This is an impersonal metaphor of inflexible bureaucracy; no person is being stepped on or injured. The shoe must read clearly as a shoe with an iron heel, not a fashionable stiletto.
Foreground: two DISTINCT small independent technology-company structures, one navy blue and one teal, with visible delicate circuit patterns / AI network motifs, retain their separate forms. Two natural realistic human hands, one emerging from each side of the frame with different plain suit sleeves, meet in a strong equal handshake over one jointly signed contract. The contract has two clearly separate signature areas and is structurally part of a small luminous bridge linking the two companies; collaboration without merger.
Law: a substantial open law book marked “قانون” and an elegant recognizable balance of justice sit next to the joint contract. Law is visibly also a usable foundation, not just a weapon: the valid contract rests on the open book and creates a protected narrow passage through the bureaucracy. Show a thin warm golden shaft of light from this contract/passsage reaching a small distant opening on the right. Just a glimmer of practical hope, no triumphant sunrise, no magical destruction of bureaucracy. Iron shoe, legal book, cooperation and hope all readable in one coherent scene. Main focal point is handshake and jointly signed paper, with looming heel as second focal point.
Style: sophisticated cinematic 3D editorial surrealism, precise architectural details, aged iron, stone, textured cream paper, subtle technology motifs, deep navy/charcoal and muted teal, restrained warm amber/gold light from contract, strong chiaroscuro, elegant professional composition, not stock business photography or cartoon clipart. Leave clean dark negative space across the top for title.
Text: at top in beautiful large correctly joined Persian typography, exactly “قراردادهای مشارکتی در IT و AI”. On the contract only “قرارداد مشارکتی”. On the law book only “قانون”. Optional tiny bottom-right “ZIABARY.IR”. No other slogans or readable text.
Constraints: Iranian national maps, flags, real politicians and religious symbols are unnecessary and must be absent. No violence or injuries, no broken human bodies, no crushed hands, no extra fingers, no merger into one company, no claims that law is abolished. Hope comes through cooperation and use of law. Make the iron heel physically unmistakable and the ray of hope small but visible.
image.review: Equal handshake, independent technology companies, joint contract with separate signatures, law book and scales, large iron-heeled shoe over paperwork and red tape, and a narrow golden path toward a distant opening are visible. Persian titles reviewed.
